import json
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/work')
from harness import run, check_plan

FAIL = []


def expect(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAIL.append(name)
        print('FAIL %s\n  got  %s\n  want %s' % (name, json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True),
                                                json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)))
    else:
        print('ok   %s' % name)


# fabric: participants 0,1,2 behind ordinary forwarders 3,4
LINKS = [[0, 3, 20], [3, 1, 20], [1, 4, 20], [4, 2, 20]]
BOOK = [{"id": "res-1", "owner": "carol", "window": [0, 100], "envelope": [[0, 5]]}]

reqs = [
    {"op": "about"},
    {"op": "load", "n": 5, "links": LINKS, "bookings": BOOK},
    {"op": "audit", "at": [0, 50]},
    {"op": "advance", "time": 10},
    # a proposal that fits: two participants with a modest demand
    {"op": "prepare", "id": "job-a", "owner": "dave", "window": [20, 60], "period": 10,
     "participants": [[0, 2], [1, 3]], "envelope": [[0, 1], [1, 1], [2, 1]], "rev": 1},
    {"op": "commit", "id": "job-a", "owner": "dave", "rev": 1},
    {"op": "audit", "at": [20]},
    # a proposal that does not fit into the lease book
    {"op": "prepare", "id": "job-b", "owner": "erin", "window": [20, 60], "period": 10,
     "participants": [[0, 1], [2, 1]], "envelope": [[0, 16], [3, 16]], "rev": 2},
    # replay of the first proposal
    {"op": "prepare", "id": "job-a", "owner": "dave", "window": [20, 60], "period": 10,
     "participants": [[0, 2], [1, 3]], "envelope": [[1, 1], [0, 1], [2, 1]], "rev": 1},
    # editing below the committed rate is blocked
    {"op": "edit", "rev": 3, "changes": [[0, 1]], "force": False},
    # forcing revokes the leases on the shrinking link
    {"op": "edit", "rev": 3, "changes": [[0, 1]], "force": True},
    {"op": "audit", "at": [20]},
    {"op": "cancel", "id": "job-a", "owner": "dave", "rev": 4},
    {"op": "commit", "id": "job-a", "owner": "dave", "rev": 5},
]

out = run(reqs)
for i, line in enumerate(out):
    text = json.dumps(line, sort_keys=True)
    print('%2d %s' % (i, text[:220]))

expect('about', out[0], {"status": "ok", "protocol": "forest-controller/3"})
expect('load', out[1], {"status": "ok", "rev": 0, "now": 0})
expect('audit', out[2], {"status": "ok", "rev": 0, "now": 0, "leases": ["res-1"],
                         "samples": [[0, [15, 20, 20, 20]], [50, [15, 20, 20, 20]]]})
expect('advance', out[3], {"status": "ok", "rev": 1, "now": 10, "expired": []})
expect('prepare status', out[4]["status"], "prepared")
ok, why = check_plan(out[4]["plan"], 5, [(0, 3), (3, 1), (1, 4), (4, 2)],
                     {0: 10, 1: 10, 2: 10, 3: 10}, [0, 1], {0: 2, 1: 3}, 10,
                     {0: 1, 1: 1, 2: 1})
expect('plan valid (%s)' % why, ok, True)
expect('commit', out[5], {"status": "ok", "id": "job-a", "rev": 2, "replay": False})
expect('audit after commit', out[6], {"status": "ok", "rev": 2, "now": 10,
                                      "leases": ["job-a", "res-1"],
                                      "samples": [[20, [14, 19, 19, 20]]]})
expect('denied capacity', out[7].get("kind"), "capacity")
expect('denied link', out[7].get("link"), 0)
expect('replay', out[8], {"status": "replay", "id": "job-a", "rev": 2, "base_rev": 1,
                           "outcome": "prepared"})
expect('edit blocked', out[9], {"status": "blocked", "rev": 2, "link": 0, "time": 10,
                                "used": 6, "capacity": 1})
expect('edit force', out[10], {"status": "ok", "rev": 3, "cancelled": ["job-a", "res-1"]})
expect('audit after force', out[11], {"status": "ok", "rev": 3, "now": 10, "leases": [],
                                      "samples": [[20, [1, 20, 20, 20]]]})
expect('cancel', out[12], {"status": "error", "code": "MISSING", "rev": 3})
expect('commit gone', out[13], {"status": "error", "code": "GONE", "rev": 3})

print()
print('FAILURES: %d' % len(FAIL))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 work/test_e2e.py
